Unfurnished No floor/site plan +3 Key features Open Storage LandCirca 1.8 acres (0.728 hectares)Prominent FrontageExcellent Transport LinksSite Can Be SplitHigh-Level FloodlightingOptional PortacabinSecure & Gated Site Description The demise comprises a triangular shaped parcel of land with a prominent frontage and direct access to Neasden Lane. The land is predominantly of concrete hardstanding and is bounded by steel palisade and solid perimeter fencing. The site benefits from high-level floodlighting, making it suitable for operational use during evening hours and an optional modular portacabin providing office and welfare space. Location - The site is located along Neasden Lane approximately 7 miles from London City Centre. The wider area is of mixed use comprising a variety of residential, commercial units, shops and eateries. Occupiers within the immediate vicinity include NSX Autos, Hardcrete and Glenn's Skip Hire. The demise benefits from excellent transport links with the North Circular Road (A406), A40, M1 and Neasden Underground station close by. Neasden is a suburb in Northwest London located approximately 19 miles south of St Albans, 46 miles east of Reading and 54 miles south east of Oxford.
